title: Deck studio — unified workspace (Gentle / Flat)
brief: One workspace for the whole flow: the outline always on the left (rows gain thumbnail and status), the selected slide in the center with View / Comment / Edit, comments and agent replies on the right. Gentle brand by default, Flat switch in every screen.

artboards.title: Workspace · armando la estructura
artboards.tradeoff: Before generating: outline editable on the left, look & feel previews in the center, slide comments on the right. Everything on one screen, so the center is narrower than a dedicated plan page

artboards.title: Workspace · generando y editando
artboards.tradeoff: During/after generation: the same outline now shows live thumbnails and status; the center edits the selected slide (inline edit, pinned comments, overflow); the agent answers in the comment thread. Dense, but nothing is lost when switching tasks

artboards.title: Outline · tarjetas
artboards.tradeoff: Slides as cards with large 132px thumbnails; the selected card expands in place with comfortable type. Best readability and status scanning; fewer rows fit without scroll

artboards.title: Outline · maestro-detalle
artboards.tradeoff: Dense one-line list plus a fixed editor panel under it (big title, real bullet inputs, agent note, drag handles). Best for long decks and drag reordering; editing is one deliberate step away

artboards.title: Outline · wireframe-primero
artboards.tradeoff: Rows show the text wireframe itself (title + keyword-highlighted bullets) instead of rendered thumbnails; the selected row grows in place. Cheapest to render and fastest to scan structure; no style preview in the list
